عشان تقدم في جامعة النيل (NU)، الخطوات هي: 
1. ادخل على موقع الجامعة ودوس على زرار "Apply Now".

3. املأ بيانات التقديم.
4. احجز اختبار تحديد مستوى اللغة الإنجليزية.
5. ارفع المستندات المطلوبة.
6. ادفع مصاريف التقديم واختبار اللغة أونلاين أو عن طريق تحويل بنكي (CIB أو QNB).
7. قدم الطلب النهائي [1] [2].

pipeline.message_meaning: Where is Nile University in Egypt?

result.answer:
نعم، جامعة النيل بتوفر بيئة قوية لدراسة علوم الحاسب (Computer Science) لأن البرنامج بيركز على فهم أنظمة الكمبيوتر الحديثة بعمق وتطبيق نظريات الحاسب والتصميم والتنفيذ لحل مشكلات واقعية [2]. كمان الجامعة بتهتم بالبحث العلمي من خلال منتدى أبحاث البكالوريوس (UGRF) اللي بيتم تنظيمه كل ترم عشان الطلاب يقدموا أبحاثهم ويشاركوا في مشاريع بحثية [3]. بالإضافة لده، فيه مركز الابتكار وريادة الأعمال (IECC) اللي بيقدم دعم في إدارة التكنولوجيا وتطوير نماذج الأعمال [4].

ممكن تلاقي فرص كويسة في دراسة علوم الحاسب في جامعة النيل لسببين أساسيين: أولاً، التركيز على التطبيق العملي لحل المشكلات الحقيقية [2]، وتانيًا، توفر منصات زي منتدى الأبحاث اللي بتشجع على الابتكار والبحث العلمي من أول سنوات الدراسة [3]. إيه أكتر جزء في دراسة الحاسبات مهتم بيه، هل هو الجانب الأكاديمي ولا ريادة الأعمال؟

sources.text:
##
## The Journey of
## UGRF
Nile University organizes the semi-annual research forum for the undergraduate students periodically, as it is held once at the end of each semester. The research forum for students is one of the most important features of Nile University as a scientific research university and reflects the university’s plan for learning through innovation and applying research.
##
All university students from various schools participate in the forum. The forum includes the provision of scientific research from the students for evaluation and publishing, in addition to research projects for students of different academic years and graduation projects for final year students.

Innovation Entrepreneurship and competitiveness Centre (IECC), is Nile University’s leading center that drives impact and economic growth.
The IECC utilizes Nile University versed know-how in management of technology, tangible industry experience with entrepreneurial approach. The result is market scale high impact innovations that increase industry competitiveness Through a team of professional practitioners, we bring necessary expertise to bridge co-founders and innovators resource gaps offering innovation management, entrepreneurial journey support, technology and business model advising, product design, engineering development and validation, go-to market strategy.

. Nile University’s degree programs are state-accredited and certified internationally.

Information Technologies and Computer Science
Biotechnology
Nile University allows students to enroll for one semester abroad at international partner universities.

sources.title: Home page | UGRF - Undergraduate Research Forum
sources.text:
##
## The Journey of
## UGRF
Nile University organizes the semi-annual research forum for the undergraduate students periodically, as it is held once at the end of each semester. The research forum for students is one of the most important features of Nile University as a scientific research university and reflects the university’s plan for learning through innovation and applying research.
##
All university students from various schools participate in the forum. The forum includes the provision of scientific research from the students for evaluation and publishing, in addition to research projects for students of different academic years and graduation projects for final year students.

sources.title: 22nd UGRF Submission Instructions — 22nd UGRF | UGRF - Undergraduate Research Forum
sources.text:
22nd UGRF Submission Instructions
The Undergraduate Research Forum (UGRF) is a flagship event of Nile University which has been going successfully for 11 years. Nile University organizes the UGRF every semester and it aims at encouraging the undergraduate students to put their course projects into practical outcome. Students present their projects in the form of 2 pages summary, videos, prototypes & applications. They get judged & evaluated by jury panel of university professors and senior researchers. Winners get recognized and receive Awards.
22nd Undergraduate Research Forum: Youth National Innovation Competition. It will be a unique competition for undergraduate and graduate students to exchange ideas, and foster. With a focus on innovation and impact, the event will feature new innovative topics and aims to support out-of-the-box ideas, aspiring to sponsor brilliant concepts and inspire solutions that can make a difference on a Wide scale.

sources.text:
in Information Technology from George Mason University, USA (1997) after completing his B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in Electronics and Communications Engineering from Cairo University.
His research has been funded by the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) and international research agencies. He has authored and co-authored more than 200 peer-reviewed publications, three books, and six book chapters, and supervised over 30 MSc and PhD theses. He is a Senior Member of IEEE and an associate editor of international scientific journals. His research interests include machine learning, data mining, image processing, deep learning, and robotics.
